versions.changelog:
Initial release of Agentic AI T-Shirt Designer for customizable clothing design workflows.

- Generate customized T-shirt and apparel designs using prompts, structured parameters, and images.
- Supports text/logo placement, multiple garment types, and print/manufacturing-on-demand use cases.
- Provides design drafts with interactive 3D viewers and multi-view previews.
- Integrates with the Craftsman Agent Manufacturing Platform to connect with suppliers.
- Secure API access via OneKey Gateway required.
